note_quote.quote: CAP-027 Scam-call alerts | Australia, outbound instant payments | Beta; requires named approval; planned general release 31 December 2027 | No named exception approved for Alder Bank

findings.reason: Scam-call alerts are still in beta in Australia and the catalogue requires a named approval before sale, but the pricing note confirms no named approver has approved this scope for Alder Bank.

findings.commitment: Hosting of Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

findings.reason: Elva's catalogue only supports AWS or GCP for regional cloud deployment in Australia, so Azure is not an offered cloud and cannot be sold even with an exception.

findings.commitment: Cloud provider for Alder's dedicated hosting environment

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will host Alder's dedicated environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

contract_quote.quote: Provider will host the Customer's dedicated environment on Amazon Web Services in the Sydney region.

findings.subject: environment
findings.reason: The RFP response promised Azure hosting but the SOW instead commits to AWS hosting for the same dedicated environment, a direct conflict on cloud provider that customer legal will likely flag.
